pages.title: Coach home (redirect)
pages.where: Not a page a coach opens from the sidebar. Going to the coach home address sends them straight to Academy (Community).
pages.summary: Shows only "Redirecting…" for a moment, then sends the coach to the Academy Community page.
pages.notes: Nothing to click here. If the coach profile can't be loaded, a short error message shows instead, such as "Unable to load your profile." Admins not viewing as a coach are sent to the admin area.

pages.title: Old programme link (redirect)
pages.where: Not reachable from the sidebar. It is an old link that sends coaches on to the Classroom in Academy.
pages.summary: Nothing to do here: the page only redirects an old programme link to the matching Classroom card, or to the main Classroom if the programme isn't found.
pages.notes: This page shows nothing itself. Point coaches to Academy → Classroom to find a programme.

pages.title: Old course archive link
pages.where: Not reachable from the sidebar. It is an old link that sends coaches to the Classroom.
pages.summary: Nothing to do here: the old archive link for a course just redirects to that course's card in the Academy Classroom.
pages.notes: This page has no screen of its own. It redirects to the course in Academy → Classroom, or to the Classroom main page if the course is not found. Point coaches to Academy → Classroom instead.

pages.title: Classroom
pages.where: Academy → Classroom
pages.summary: Browse the training courses, see how far you are through each one, and open a lesson.
controls: **Course cards** (Start Here, Coach Action Plan, Going Pro, Get Calls, Win Clients, Coach Clients): each shows a cover, a short description and a progress bar such as "3 of 10 complete"; clicking opens the first lesson
**The Portfolio System** banner under the course cards: opens the step-by-step map, each step opens its lesson
**Open the map** strip with an arrow at the right of the banner (on small screens it shows as an arrow only)
**The Vault** section at the bottom: extra courses on books, talks and how-tos
**Show** / **Hide** button with a chevron at the right of The Vault: opens or closes the Vault
**Vault course cards** (Personal growth, Book summaries, Tools & set-up): open the first lesson
**Coach talks** row of video thumbnails inside the Vault, with the speaker's name and length
pages.notes: The Vault starts closed for new coaches and opens by itself once you have started a Vault lesson; Show or Hide is remembered on this device. Lessons hidden from coaches, including drafts, are not counted or linked. Progress shows as plain lesson counts until it has loaded.

pages.title: Classroom course entry
pages.where: Academy → Classroom, then open a course
pages.summary: This page has nothing to see: it sends the coach straight to the first lesson of the course, or back to the Classroom list if the course is retired or empty.
pages.notes: Coaches never stay on this page, because it always redirects. Ava should point them to the Classroom list or the lesson page instead. A course that does not exist shows a not-found page.

pages.title: System
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → System (open the Classroom page, then the System map)
pages.summary: See the whole lead-to-client map in one picture, open the lesson behind each step, and try out the numbers you need for your own client target.
controls: **Classroom** link at top left, goes back to the Classroom
Five numbered sections: **Find Your Ideal Clients**, **Set Up Your Pipeline**, **Lead Generation & Win Clients**, **Build Authority**, **Keep Clients**
Lesson cards such as **Choose Your Ideal Client**, **Optimise Your LinkedIn Profile**, **Onboard New Clients**, hover or focus to read a summary, click to open the lesson
**Customise funnel** button in the Lead Generation & Win Clients section
In the funnel box: sliders **Reachable**, **Interested**, **Booked**, **Qualified**, **Won**
**New clients** box with minus and plus buttons and a number field
**Reset** and **Close funnel settings** (X) in the funnel box
Flow map boxes such as **Prospect Lists**, **Interest Sequence**, **Reply Sequence**, **Discovery Call**, **Value Session**, **New Client**, hover for details
Diamond questions **Reachable?**, **Interested?**, **Booked?**, **Qualified?**, **Won?** with YES and NO paths
**Open lesson** button in the hover card or detail panel, for steps with a lesson
Detail panel under the map when you click a box, with a **Close** button
Info (i) icon on each section header shows its purpose
pages.notes: The funnel numbers are an estimate that works backward from your New clients target, and are saved only in your own browser. Newsletter, Email Your List and Post on Social cards show "Lesson coming soon." and do not open. The Discovery Call, Value Session and a few other boxes may have no lesson link.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → Weekly Focus (the page opens from the Classroom)
pages.summary: Read this week's focus and action, listen to the audio, and look back at earlier weeks.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top (goes back to the Classroom)
**This Week’s Focus** label above the title (shows **Past Focus** when you open an older week)
Cover picture, title and short description of the week
**This week’s action** box with the one thing to do
**Listen** audio player (only appears if the week has audio)
Lesson text under the audio (only appears if the week has text)
**Open** button at the bottom, named after the learning path, e.g. "Open [path name]"
**Back to this week** button (only when viewing a past week)
**Past weeks** list with an **Open** link on each week
pages.notes: The audio and lesson text load a moment after the page and only show for signed-in members. The Past weeks list only appears once there are earlier weeks. Opening a past week shows its week number next to the path name.

pages.title: Weekly Focus
pages.where: Academy → Classroom → open a Weekly Focus week
pages.summary: Read one week's focus, its action, and any audio or lesson text, then jump to the related learning path or a past week.
controls: **Classroom** link at the top (back arrow) to return to the Classroom
**This Week’s Focus** or **Past Focus** label above the title
**This week’s action** box with the action to do
**Listen** audio player (shows only if the week has audio)
Lesson text below the action (shows only if the week has a written lesson)
**Open** button for the related path, named like "Open [path name]"
**Back to this week** button (only when viewing a past week)
**Past weeks** list with an **Open** link on each row to switch weeks
pages.notes: Audio and lesson text load a moment after the page and only appear if that week has them. The Past weeks list only shows when there are earlier weeks. A week link that doesn't exist gives a not-found page.}

pages.title: Resource Library
pages.where: Academy → Resources
pages.summary: Browse, search and open every guide, sheet, deck and template for winning clients, running sessions and using the Profit System.
controls: **Search inside every resource** box at the top of the page, searches the text inside resources
**All**, **Docs**, **Sheets**, **Slides**, **Files**, **Videos**, **Reading** buttons under the search box, each with a count, to show only one type
**Get clients** section, tap to open its resources
**Keep clients** section, tap to open its resources
**Profit System** section, opens in three columns: Vision, Velocity and Value
**Search inside resources** box in the left contents list
**Overview** link in the left contents list, back to this page
**The Resource Library** link at the top of the contents list
**Collapse contents** / **Expand contents** button to fold the left list (on larger screens)
**Contents** button to open the list on a phone
**The old Resources list** link at the bottom of the contents list
pages.notes: Sections start closed; tapping one opens its resources, and tapping a resource opens its page. Searching or choosing a type replaces the three sections with a list of matching resources. Search inside pages works once the page text has loaded after sign-in.

pages.title: One resource page
pages.where: Academy → Resources → open any resource page
pages.summary: Read one resource page, then copy its sheets or slides, download its files, watch its videos, or print it as a PDF.
controls: **Watch the lesson** button at the top right, shown only on pages that have a lesson
**Download PDF** button at the top right, shown only on pages with written text
**Make a copy** button on Google Sheets and Google Slides blocks
**View the master** button on Google Sheet blocks
**Open** button on Google Slides blocks
**Download** button on file blocks
**Open in Drive** button on file blocks
**How to run it** link beside a group of sheet tabs, shown on some sheets
**Watch the video** button, shown when a video can't play on the page
**Previous** and **Next** links at the bottom, which move through the whole library in order
pages.notes: The page shows "Loading…" first, and if it fails it says "This resource didn't load. Sign in again, or refresh the page." Which blocks appear (text, sheets, slides, files, videos, reading links) depends on the page. Some reading links may be crossed out with a warning note when the link is broken.

pages.title: Resources list
pages.where: Academy → Resources → ← The Resource Library link leads to the Resource Library; this list is the older link list page
pages.summary: Browse and search the Academy's resource links, grouped by area, and open any of them in a new tab.
controls: **← The Resource Library** link at the top, goes back to the Resource Library page
Area buttons at the top left, switch between areas (the first one, Coach Delivery, is open by default)
**Search resources…** box at the top right, shows matching resources from all areas in a table
Line under the buttons saying how many resources are in the chosen area
Section rows with an arrow, click to open or close a section and see its count
Topic rows with an arrow, click to open or close a group inside a section
Document rows with an arrow, click to open or close a document that has several tab links
**Open full document** link inside an opened document, opens the whole file
Resource links in the **Resource** column, each opens in a new tab
**Type** column, shows what kind of resource it is, e.g. document, video or link
**Topic** column, shown only in search results
**No resources match your search.** message when a search finds nothing
pages.notes: This is the original link list, kept while the Resource Library is on test. Admins also see a trash icon to delete resources, but coaches never see it, so don't offer it.

pages.title: Ava
pages.where: Not in the sidebar tabs listed; open the Ava page at /coach/ava (the Ava assistant page in the Profit Coach app)
pages.summary: The coach opens the full Ava page to chat with Ava, the assistant.
pages.notes: The page file only shows the Ava page and gives no labels, so Ava cannot describe any buttons or fields on it. No sidebar item for this page appears in the names provided.

pages.title: My Blueprint
pages.where: My Blueprint in the sidebar
pages.summary: See your Blueprint overview: the setup checklist, every Blueprint page with its status and chat count, and open a page to work on it.
controls: **Your Blueprint** heading with a **?** button (How your Blueprint works) that opens a pop-up
**Where you are** in the pop-up: three steps, the first opens a call with Ava
**Why we build it for you** video in the pop-up
**How status works** in the pop-up: the five statuses with page counts
**List** and **Board** switch at the top right
Setup checklist under the intro text
Contents list of page rows, each with an icon, title, short line, chat count or "N new", and a status pill
Board view: a column for each status, with a card per page
Status names: Needs you, BCA, In progress, Review, Done
**Sign off this page** button on a page when its status is Review (on the page itself, not this overview)
**Chat** panel on the right of a page, where you message BCA about that page
pages.notes: The setup checklist is the only version coaches see; the Checklist/Timeline switch and Timeline are admin-only. Admins using the app as a coach also see Ava's drafts, Release, Approve to send and a Launch back button; coaches never see these. Pages BCA builds look quieter until you have answered the cards that need you.

pages.title: One Blueprint page
pages.where: My Blueprint → pick a page from the contents list (or a link to a single page)
pages.summary: Read one page of your practice plan on its own, with the same content as in the full Blueprint.
controls: **Parts of this page** row of buttons at the top of a page made of parts (like About you), ticked when nothing is left for you to answer
**You tell us** and **BCA writes it, you can edit it** key showing which boxes are yours to fill and which BCA wrote
**How to do it, in the Classroom** box at the bottom with links to the lessons for that page
**Lead lists** page: shows the lists we built for you and how many people came in from each
**Decision Record** page: shows what BCA proposes, then what you agreed on your Decision Call, marked **Proposed by BCA** or **Agreed**
pages.notes: The page title and the Download menu are not on this screen; they sit on the main Blueprint page around it. The Blueprint and Command pages do not open here. Admin-only parts: the Ava's plan section on Lead lists, the Edit and Save buttons on the Decision Record, and the Write my blueprint bar, so never offer these to a coach; the Who does what group is also hidden from coaches.

pages.title: Full Blueprint
pages.where: My Blueprint → Blueprint
pages.summary: Read your whole Practice Blueprint as one document, see what BCA still needs from you, and jump to any chapter or page.
controls: **Still needed from you** box at the top, listing each missing item with its page name; click one to jump to it
**Talk it through** button in that box, which opens Ava
**Contents** list with numbered chapters and a link to each page
Chapter sections, each with its pages in order
**How to do it, in the Classroom** box on pages that have guides, with links to the Classroom
**Edit** button on the Decision Record page
**Lead lists** page showing the lists built for you and how many people came in
Footer note from Business Coach Academy
pages.notes: The cover and the Still needed box show only when your blueprint has loaded; the Still needed box is hidden when nothing is missing. The build bar (Write my blueprint, Write the rest, Rewrite everything, Stop after this one) is for BCA only, so never offer it to coaches. The Decision Record Edit button and Ava's plan in Lead lists are also admin-only; coaches only read those.  Download and print options exist in the code but are not on this page.

pages.title: Your plan (jobs)
pages.where: My Blueprint → Jobs (not linked from the sidebar)
pages.summary: A list or board of launch jobs with progress, status and chat, but it is admin-only for now and coaches are sent back to My Blueprint.
pages.notes: Coaches who open this page are redirected to /coach/blueprint (My Blueprint), so Ava should never send a coach here. Only admins see the Your plan list and board, the List and Board switch, and the job chats.

pages.title: BOSS Score
pages.where: Keep Clients → BOSS Score
pages.summary: Pick a client or prospect (or add a new person) and score their business together on the BOSS grid, then read the charts and insights.
controls: **Choose someone from the list** picker at the top of the page, to open a client or prospect
**+ Add new person** option in the picker: enter their details, then click **Start session**
**Change session** in the session menu (top right) once someone is picked, to switch person
**View scorecard** in the session menu, shown only if the person has taken the BOSS Score; opens a pop-up with their results
**Copy client link** in the session menu, copies a link to the client's dashboard (score them first)
BOSS score dials strip at the top of the scoring area, showing the total and pillar scores
BOSS grid, where you set each playbook's score and add notes; changes save automatically and show **Scores saved.**
**Owner level completeness** card with a bar for each level
**BOSS wheel** card showing area scores
Answer mix card with the on-track, building and needs-attention breakdown
**Insights** card with a refresh button and tabs **Overview**, **Levels**, **Pillars**, **Areas**
**See full overview** button under Overview insights, opens a pop-up with the Top 3 Priorities
**Priority playbooks** buttons under a level, pillar or area insight, which open that playbook's score sheet
pages.notes: Nothing is saved until a person is picked or a new person is started with Start session. The Charts section only appears when scoring together is off, and the Score together checkbox is hidden here. The admin-only view (all coaches, coach picker, prospect priority matrix) is never shown to coaches.

pages.title: Calls
pages.where: Win Clients → Calls
pages.summary: See every booked sales call on a calendar or list, mark how each call went, add a call for a prospect, and set up your booking pages.
controls: **Search calls…** box at the top
**Filter** button (on the calendar: Calendars and Type choices; on the list: Timing and Call status)
**Sort** button (list view only): Sort by Call time, Date added, Prospect or Call status, plus Order
**Booking pages** button opens your booking calendars, weekly hours and connections
Calendar and list switch (two icon buttons: **Calendar view** and **List view**)
**Add a call** button: pick a prospect in the **Add a call** pop-up, then choose a calendar and time and press **Confirm**
Calendar controls: **Today**, previous and next arrows, and **Day**, **Week**, **Month**
Calendar key: Confirmed, Completed, No-show, Cancelled, Imported
Click a call on the calendar to see its details, **Join meeting**, **Watch recording**, status buttons and **Open contact**
List columns: Prospect, Contact info, Date added, Call time, Calendar, Call status (a drop-down to change it)
**Connect calendar** prompt on the calendar: shows your Google or Outlook events next to your calls

In Booking pages: **Your pages** (Edit page and copy link), **Booking calendars** with **New calendar**, on/off switch, Edit and Delete in each row's menu, **Weekly hours** with **Save hours**, and a **Calls** link to go back
pages.notes: Page heading is Win Clients. Clicking a call in the list opens the client's page only if the coach has Keep Clients access. The Calendars filter on the list only applies to admins, and the Coach filter and column are admin-only. Booking pages lets a coach connect Google or Outlook so busy times stay off their booking page and calls get meeting links.

pages.title: Campaigns
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns
pages.summary: See all your LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp campaigns, turn them on or off, start new ones, and check what needs doing today.
controls: **New Campaign** button at the top right (opens a **Create campaign** pop-up: **Name**, **Channel** LinkedIn/Email/WhatsApp, then **Blank** or **Templates**)
**Sending settings** button at the top right (only shows once LinkedIn is connected)
Campaign table with columns **Campaign**, **Via**, **Connect**, **Replies**; click a row to open that campaign
On/off switch at the start of each row (shows On or Off)
Drag handle at the start of each row to reorder campaigns
Three-dot **Campaign actions** menu on each row: **Edit**, **Settings**, **Duplicate**, **Save as template**, **Archive**, **Delete**
**Duplicate campaign** pop-up: choose **Steps**, **People** or **Steps and people**, then **Duplicate**
**Archived** bar under the table; click it to show archived campaigns, then use **Unarchive** in the row menu
Activity panel on the right with tabs **To do**, **Planned**, **Done**
**Social Selling Index** card on the right, with a **Breakdown** link
**Pending invites** card on the right with an **Auto-clean** switch
**Connect LinkedIn** button on the right card (when LinkedIn isn't connected yet)
**Create campaign** button in the empty state when you have no campaigns
pages.notes: Connect LinkedIn first, and Gmail/Outlook for email or WhatsApp for those channels, or a campaign switch won't turn on. The page also has the Prospects and Lead Magnets views, reached through the Get Calls tabs, and those are separate pages. The floating **Sample data** switch is only for staff and the demo coach, so never offer it to coaches.</br>

pages.title: One campaign
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns, then click a campaign
pages.summary: Run one outreach campaign: turn it on or off, add people, write the steps and see how it is doing.
controls: **← Campaigns** link at the top to go back to the list
On/Off switch next to the campaign name (turns the campaign on or off)
Pencil button (**Edit campaign name**) next to the name
**Save template** button: saves the steps and sending settings as your own template, not the people
**Duplicate** button: pop-up to copy **Steps**, **People** or **Steps and people**; the copy starts switched off
**Settings** button: opens the campaign settings, where you can also archive or delete it
Overview: **By status** card with **View all** and **Add prospects**, a **Conversion** card and a **Daily activity** chart

Overview when empty: **Set up steps** or **Review steps**, and **Add people** options such as **Already in the system**, **Add one person**, **Sales Navigator**, **Google Maps**, **Google Search**, **Upload CSV**
Prospects tab: table of people in the campaign, with add, pause, resume, move and delete actions
Steps tab: build the message sequence, with a template choice (**Choose a template** pop-up with **Your templates** and **BCA templates**)
**Before you launch** box: a line such as "Fix 1 thing before this can go live" with **Show** / **Hide**
**Join a BCA group test** box with **Show** / **Hide**, **Test** list and **Join this test**; once in, **Leave test**
pages.notes: The On switch only works once the right account is connected (LinkedIn, email or WhatsApp, depending on the campaign) and the campaign is not archived. The group test box does not show on email campaigns, and only shows when a test is available. Lead magnet campaigns open on their own lead magnet page instead of this one.

pages.title: Pending connection requests
pages.where: Get Calls → Campaigns, then the ← Campaigns link's page opens the invites page (reached from the Campaigns tab; there is no tab of its own in the Get Calls row)
pages.summary: Withdraw old pending LinkedIn connection requests by hand or turn on auto-clean so new invites keep going out.
controls: **← Campaigns** link at the top, goes back to Campaigns
**Pending load** card with a dial showing how many requests are pending
**Refresh** button in the Pending load card
**Auto-clean** card with an on/off switch (**Auto-clean pending invites**)
**Withdraw now** card with a number box and **Decrease** / **Increase** buttons for how many of the oldest to withdraw
**Withdraw (number) oldest** button, asks you to confirm first
List of pending requests showing name, description and how long ago it was sent
**Withdraw** button on each request in the list, asks you to confirm
**Nothing pending** message when the list is empty
pages.notes: LinkedIn must be connected for the list to load; otherwise an error message appears at the top. Withdrawing cannot be undone. Auto-clean keeps pending requests under a set number, and new invites slow down or pause when too many are pending.

pages.title: One lead magnet
pages.where: Get Calls → Lead Magnets → open a lead magnet (e.g. the BOSS Score)
pages.summary: See who opted in, started and finished a lead magnet, share its link, and edit the follow-up emails sent after people take it.
controls: **Settings** button at the top: pop-up called Lead magnet settings, where you choose who emails people after they take one (**This app** or **My old CRM**)
**Share** button: pop-up with **Your public URL** field and share settings
**Add a public link** link: shows only if you have no public URL yet, opens the Share pop-up
**Copy** button next to the page link
**Edit your page** button (BOSS Score only)
Date range dropdown (Last 7 days, Last 14 days, Last 30 days, Last 90 days, All time, Custom range) on Overview and People
**By stage** card on Overview with a **View all** link; click a stage to see those people
**Opted in** and **Completed** dials on Overview
Stage filters **All**, **Opted in**, **Started**, **Completed** and **Search name or email** box on People
People table with columns Person, Stage, Score, When; click a row to open that person
Sequence tabs under Sequences, each with a step builder for follow-up messages
**Notify me when** panel beside the sequence: **Bell**, **Email**, **WhatsApp** switches and **Add alert** button
pages.notes: Emails from this app come from your connected email; if none is connected, the Settings pop-up has a **Connect your email** link. The Opted in dial and views count show for the BOSS Score only. If the lead magnet is not found, a **Back to lead magnets** link appears.

pages.title: Keep Clients
pages.where: Keep Clients in the sidebar (opens on the Clients tab)
pages.summary: See everyone you coach with their price, join date and BOSS Score, add new clients, and edit their details.
controls: **Add client** button at the top right opens the add form (it shows automatically when you have no clients yet)
**LinkedIn profile** field and **Import** button in the add form pull in a name and business from LinkedIn
**Or add them yourself** fields in the add form: **Person**, **Business**, **Joined**, **Price / month**, **Problem notes**, then **Save client**
**Add many** button opens **Add all your clients at once**: paste your list from Excel or Google Sheets, use **Copy the column headings**, then press the **Add** button showing the client count
**Search** box appears once you have 6 or more clients
**Your best clients** card shows what your best clients have in common: Sector, Turnover, Team size, How they found you
Client table with columns **Person**, **Business**, **Joined**, **With you**, **Price / month**, **BOSS**, **Notes**
Click a client row to open its edit box; click again to close
Edit box fields: **Sector**, **How they found you**, **Turnover**, **Team size**, **Result you got them**, **More like them? (1 to 5)**, **LinkedIn profile**, then **Save**
**Open BOSS Score** or **Run BOSS Score** link in the edit box (also the score or **Run** link in the BOSS column)
**Coaching workspace** link in the edit box
Small LinkedIn icon next to a client name opens their profile
pages.notes: If a coach doesn't have access to the client area, they are sent to the Academy community page instead. Admins who are not viewing as a coach are sent to the admin area. The Keep Clients tab row (Clients, BOSS Score, Playbooks, Profit Levers, Client Simulator) is shared and links to other pages.

pages.title: Community
pages.where: Academy → Community
pages.summary: Read and write posts, wins and questions with other coaches, filter the feed, and see the next live call.
controls: **Write something…** box at the top opens the new post box
**Title** and body fields in the new post box (body has formatting and @mentions)
**Where to post** drop-down in the new post box, pick a category before posting
**Add photos or videos** button and **Add a video** button (paste a YouTube, Loom, Vimeo or Wistia link, or upload a file)
**Add a poll** button, with **Option 1**, **Option 2** and **Add option**
**Post** and **Cancel** buttons in the new post box
**All** and category buttons row to filter posts by category
Filter icon menu with **All posts**, **Unread**, **Read**, **Favourites**
**Mark all as read** shown when the Unread filter is on
Next live call line under the post box (shows **Live** when a call is on), links to the Calendar
Click a post to open it and comment; its menu (⋯) has **Add to favourites**, and it can be marked as unread
**Previous**, page numbers and **Next** at the bottom when there is more than one page
Side panel next to the feed (community sidebar)
pages.notes: Admins also get a Schedule button, Write with Ava and Also send to WhatsApp for Announcements, plus a Scheduled posts section; coaches never see these, and only admins can post in Announcements. The Feedback category only shows if the coach's plan includes the feedback channel. The old Map tab now lives on the Members page.

pages.title: One community post
pages.where: Academy → Community, then open a post from the feed
pages.summary: Read one community post opened from the Academy community feed.
pages.notes: This page has no content of its own; the post is shown by the shared community feed layout around it. Ava can't describe the post's buttons from this page alone.

pages.title: Calendar
pages.where: Academy → Calendar
pages.summary: See upcoming and past community events and calls in a month, week or list view, open one for details, and watch recordings.
controls: **Today** button at top left jumps back to the current date
**Previous month** / **Next month** arrows (they say week in week view) move the calendar
Time zone link under the title (for example "5:00pm London time") opens a list of time zones
**Calendar layout** drop-down with **Week** and **Month** (calendar view only)
**Calendar view** and **List view** icon buttons switch how events are shown
Subscribe button at top right adds the calendar to your own calendar app
**Upcoming** and **Previous calls** switch inside list view
Click an event to open its card with date, time, link or "In person", description and cover image
**Watch recording** button on past events that have a recording
**Previous** and **Next** page buttons under the list when there are more than 6 events
**Close** button on the event card
pages.notes: On a phone the page opens in list view because the calendar grid is hidden on small screens. Adding, editing and cancelling events, saving recording links, and cancellation reasons are admin-only, so never offer them to coaches. Coaches only see events tagged for their access level.

pages.title: Members
pages.where: Academy → Community → Members
pages.summary: Browse everyone in the Profit Coach community as a list or on a map, see who is online, and add your own location to the map.
controls: **Members**, **Online** and **Admins** buttons at the top, each with a count, to filter the list
**List** and **Map** switch to change the view
Sort button (arrows icon) with options **Last online**, **Name** and **Program level**, each in both directions
Each member card shows photo, name, an Online or Offline tag, @name, business name, short bio, last seen, joined date and location
**View profile** button on a card (only for members listed in the directory)
Page buttons **Previous**, **Next** and page numbers, 20 members per page, with a range like 1-20 of N
Right side box **Profit Coach Community** with Members, Online and Admins counts, and **Recently active** photos (hover for a quick profile)
**This Week's Calls** box on the right with **View full calendar →**
On the map: **Your location** box with a **City, region, country** field and a save icon (**Save location**)
On the map: **Place pin on map** button (shows **Update map pin** once you have a pin) that opens **Your map pin** with **Save pin** and **Cancel**
pages.notes: The Online or Offline tag and green dots only appear when presence is working. The map only shows members who have a location and a pin. The **Add event** button never shows here.

pages.title: Contacts (redirect)
pages.where: Not reachable from the sidebar. Opening this address sends the coach straight to Keep Clients → Clients.
pages.summary: This page only shows "Redirecting to clients…" and moves the coach to the Clients page.
pages.notes: Nothing to do on this page. If a coach asks about contacts, point them to Keep Clients → Clients.

pages.title: Contact (redirect)
pages.where: Not a page coaches open directly; it is reached from a link to a contact and moves on to Boss Pro at once.
pages.summary: Shows "Opening Boss Pro…" for a moment, then sends the coach to that contact's Boss Pro page.
pages.notes: Nothing to do here. If the coach does not have access to the client hub, they are sent to Academy (Community) instead. Point coaches to Keep Clients → BOSS Score for their clients' scores and reports.

pages.title: Conversations
pages.where: Get Calls → Conversations
pages.summary: Read and reply to your LinkedIn, WhatsApp and email messages in one inbox.
controls: **Get Calls** heading with the line about every reply in one inbox
**Start a conversation** plus button above the inbox list, which opens a pop-up with a **Search people** box
**Add a new person** in that pop-up, with fields **Name**, **Email**, **Phone**, **LinkedIn URL** and the button **Create & message**
**This person's reply** chip, labelled **Reply** until set, to mark them interested, neutral or not interested, with **Clear** to undo
**Ava:** suggestion bar with **Use draft** and **Dismiss** buttons

Message box tools: **Add image**, **Attach file**, **Voice note** (**Record with mic** or **Upload audio file**), **Send video message**, **Emoji**, and **Snippets** with **Search Snippet/Folder** and **Insert**
Round **Suggest a reply** button in the corner of the message box for an Ava draft
**Insert BOSS Scorecard link** and **Insert personalised BOSS Scorecard link** buttons in the message box
**Discard** and **Send** buttons, with a clock button (**Send options**) offering **Send now** or **Send later**, which opens **Schedule your message** with Date and Time
Contact details: **Business name** box, **Call**, **Email** and **LinkedIn profile** buttons, tags, and click-to-edit Email, Phone, Title, Business, Website and LinkedIn
**Same person as another thread** link, then **Same person as** box to merge threads
**Possible duplicates** box with **Merge into this**
Campaigns list for a person, with the plus button **Add to a campaign**, remove buttons and a **Past** list
You can drop files onto the message panel to attach them
pages.notes: Messages only appear once LinkedIn, WhatsApp or email is connected. Ava's drafts and the scheduled auto-reply message only show when Ava has made a suggestion for that conversation. The inbox itself loads in a separate part that is not fully shown here, so its list and filters are not described.

pages.title: Income
pages.where: This page is not in the sidebar or the section tabs, and the code shows no link to it. A coach opens it by going to the /coach/income address directly.
pages.summary: Log the money you receive and see your totals by client and month.
controls: **Last 3 months (logged)** box at the top showing your total for the last three months
**Income entries** tab to add and manage payments
**Client × month** tab with a table of clients by month, plus a **Total** column and a **Column totals** row
**Add income** form on Income entries
**Amount** field in Add income
**Date received** field in Add income
**Client (optional)** drop-down in Add income, with **Other / unallocated** as the default
**Note** field in Add income
**Add entry** button to save the payment
**Edit** link on each row in the table, which opens fields with **Save** and **Cancel** buttons
**Delete** link on each row in the table, which asks you to confirm
Table columns **Date**, **Client**, **Amount**, **Note**, **Actions**
pages.notes: Entries are cash received, such as bank transfer or card. Payments with no client are grouped under Other / unallocated. An admin who is not viewing as a coach is sent back to the admin area.

pages.title: Content
pages.where: Get Calls → Content
pages.summary: Write, schedule and publish your LinkedIn posts, and see how they land.
controls: **Connect LinkedIn** button on the card shown before LinkedIn is connected
**What do you want to talk about?** box in Compose for the post text
**Image**, **Video**, **Document** and **Link** buttons under the post box (Image has **Upload** and **Templates** tabs; Templates makes a Quote card with **Generate & attach**)
**Category…** field next to the post buttons
**Save draft** button in Compose
**Schedule** button in Compose, then pick a date and time under **Publish at** and press **Confirm**
**Post** button in Compose to publish now
**Refresh** button at the top right of the tabs
**Import from LinkedIn** button in Insights to bring in past posts and newsletter issues
**Headline**, **Website button label**, **Website URL** and **Quote card subtitle** fields in Settings, saved with **Save composer settings**
**Reconnect** and **Run due posts** buttons in Settings
pages.notes: LinkedIn must be connected first. Until then the Compose screen is blurred behind the connect card and every other tab is locked. The Queue tab shows a count of scheduled posts and the Library tab shows a count of drafts. The Newsletter is on its own tab in Get Calls.

pages.title: Membership
pages.where: There is no sidebar item for it. Coaches open it from the membership link or button they are sent (the page is /coach/membership).
pages.summary: See your membership level and billing status, compare Core, Premium and VIP, and join or switch a level.
controls: **Manage billing** button at the top (only if you already have a subscription), opens the billing page
**WhatsApp** button and phone and email help links at the top
**Choose your level** (hero button, also at the bottom) scrolls down to the plans
**Watch: how membership works** video play button at the top
Status card such as "You're on …" with Renews or Access until date
**Membership levels** comparison table of Core, Premium (marked **Most popular**) and VIP
Small info icon next to each feature name, which shows a pop-up explaining it
**Join Core**, **Join Premium**, **Join VIP** buttons with monthly prices under the table
**Pay yearly** links (Save 2 months) for Core and Premium
**What each one gives you** cards explaining every feature
**Frequently asked questions** list, tap a question to open the answer
Banners: "You're still in your first 6 months", "Your membership is complimentary", or "You don't have an active membership yet"
pages.notes: Which banner and status card appear depends on the coach's billing: subscriber, first 6 months, complimentary or no membership. Manage billing only shows for coaches with a subscription, and payments are handled securely through Stripe. Yearly links are only shown for Core and Premium, not VIP.

pages.title: Newsletter
pages.where: Get Calls → Newsletter
pages.summary: Write, edit and organise your newsletter issues, and read the ones already published on LinkedIn.
controls: **Newsletter issues** list on the left, grouped as **Drafts**, **Scheduled** and **Published** (each group folds; drag the grip beside a draft to reorder the queue)
**Name and call to action** link at the top of the list, to set your newsletter's name and call to action in My Blueprint
**Import from LinkedIn** button in the **Bring in your past issues** box (reads past issues, posts nothing)
**Title** field and **Write your issue…** text box for a draft
Formatting bar: **Text style** (Normal text, Heading, Subheading), Bold, Italic, Strikethrough, Link, Bullet list, Numbered list, Quote, Add a picture, Undo, Redo
**Alt text & link** button, shown when a picture in the draft is selected
**Add a cover photo** box (then **Change cover** and **Remove**) opening a **Cover photo** pop-up with **Templates** and **Upload your own**, plus **Use this cover**
**Copy** button on a draft, copies the issue with its pictures
**Status** menu on a draft: **Draft**, **Scheduled on LinkedIn…** (pick a time, then **Set**) or **Published**
**Post about this issue** section under a draft, for the feed post
**Previous issue** and **Next issue** arrows in the top bar
**Copy text** and **Open on LinkedIn** buttons on a published issue (read only)
pages.notes: Drafts save automatically as you type, and you'll see Saving… / Saved. Published issues imported from LinkedIn can't be edited. The cover pop-up's "Ava makes it" option and "Let Ava do it" button are admin-only, so never offer them.

pages.title: Playbooks
pages.where: Keep Clients → Playbooks
pages.summary: Browse ready-made guides to share with your clients, each with your link added for you.
controls: **Keep Clients** page heading with a short description of the guides
**Grid** button at top right to see playbooks as cards
**List** button at top right to see playbooks as rows
Playbooks grouped under headings for each area
Each playbook shows its level, name, a short description and the number of actions inside
**Open playbook** link on each card or row to open that guide
pages.notes: The Keep Clients tabs row (Clients, BOSS Score, Playbooks, Profit Levers, Client Simulator) sits at the top. If a coach does not have access to the Keep Clients area, they are sent to Academy instead of seeing this page. The guide link includes the coach's own link only if they have a coach link set up.}

pages.title: Pipeline
pages.where: Win Clients → Pipeline
pages.summary: See everyone you are talking to and where they are up to, add or import prospects, and open one to follow up.
controls: **Search prospects…** box in the toolbar
**Filter** button (Status, Tags, Exclude tags, Assessment, Next call)
**Sort** button (Sort by, Order)
**Group** button (list view only, Group by and Group order)
**Cards** button in pipeline view (Show on cards, Customize pipeline)
**Columns** button in list view (Shown and Hidden columns, drag to reorder)
**Import** button (Choose CSV, Download template, then Import)
**Export** button (Shown columns or All columns)
**Add prospect** button, opens a form with Prospect name, Email (optional), Business name (optional), a copy-my-assessment-link tick box and **Create prospect**
Pipeline and list view switch (**Pipeline view** and **List view** buttons)
**Customize pipeline** side panel (Add column, rename, Show tick, Sections)
Saved views bar in list view (**+ View** to add, rename, duplicate or delete a view)
Click a prospect to open their page
Status badge in list view (click to change status or Use auto)
pages.notes: The Pipeline and List switch is the only way to change between board and table, and the Group button and saved views bar only show in list view. The Coach filter and coach column are admin-only and are never shown to coaches. Booking a call from a prospect needs a calendar turned on in Calls → Booking pages.}

pages.title: One prospect
pages.where: Win Clients → Pipeline, then click a person (also opens from Get Calls → Campaigns, Prospects or Conversations)
pages.summary: See one prospect's conversation, details, activity, calls and notes in one place, and message them or book a call.
controls: **Back link** on the left details panel, named Prospects, Pool, Campaigns or Conversations depending on where you came from
**Business name** field under the person's name
**Call**, **Email** and **LinkedIn profile** icon buttons (greyed out until that detail is added)
**Tags** under the icon buttons
**Email**, **Phone**, **Title**, **Business**, **Website** and **LinkedIn** fields, click to edit
**Possible duplicates** box with **Merge into this** button
**Same person as another thread** link to join threads from other channels
**Add to a campaign** (+) button with the campaigns the person is in, and a remove (x) on each
**Suggest a reply** button, **Use draft** and **Dismiss** on Ava's suggestion
**Send**, **Discard**, **Send later**, plus image, file, voice note, video and emoji icons in the message box
**Book a call** button in the Calls tab, **Join meeting** link on a call
**Add a private note…** box with **Add note** button in the Notes tab
**Refresh** button next to the tabs
Delete prospect pop-up asking **Delete**
pages.notes: The page sits under the Win Clients header, but the shared Win Clients tabs just link to other pages. Notes are internal only and never sent to the prospect. Sending messages needs the matching channel (LinkedIn, WhatsApp or email) to be connected.  Admin-only parts such as coach switching are never shown to coaches.

pages.title: Scoreboard
pages.where: Win Clients → Scoreboard
pages.summary: Set an income target and see how many messages, calls and clients it takes, then try what-if numbers by typing or dragging.
controls: **Income targets a month** buttons at the top: switch the income amounts to compare on or off (at least one stays on)
**Saved on this device** note: your numbers are kept on this device only
**Income a month at these numbers** big figure with a bar showing Now and What-if against your targets
**What if** heading with an info icon: hover for how the board works
**Good** and **Great** buttons: fill in the target rates (Great is what the new scripts aim for)
**Funnel order** and **Biggest gap** buttons: change the order of the rows
**Now** boxes in the table: type your own numbers over the example
Drag any dot on a bar or any **A month** bar to see what changes; blue numbers are a what-if and not real
**+ Add a lead source** button: add your own source such as referrals (up to 8), with a name box and a **×** to remove it
Table columns: **Step**, **Target**, **Now**, **Diff**, **If hit**, **Status**, **A month**
Groups of rows: **Leads**, **Calls**, **Keep clients**, then **What it comes to** (Clients at once, Income a month, A new client every)
pages.notes: It starts from an example (400 outbound a month, Good rates, £12k target), not the coach's real data. Numbers are saved only on this device once something is changed. Clients stop at a cap, about the most one person can coach.

pages.title: Scripts
pages.where: Win Clients → Scripts
pages.summary: Browse every script for your talks with owners, in call order, and open one to use it.
controls: **Win Clients** heading with the description of scripts for talks with owners, from first message to the close
Script cards in a grid, each with a picture, a small label, a title and a short description; click one to open that script
**Open** bar at the bottom of each script card
**Call simulator** banner under the cards, with a row of owner faces
**Start practising** button in the Call simulator banner, opens Call Practice
pages.notes: The cards themselves come from a fixed script list, so coaches cannot add or edit them on this page. The **Your levers** card is admin-only, so never offer it to coaches. An older layout shown with ?v=1 in the link is only for comparison, so don't send coaches to it.

pages.title: One script
pages.where: Win Clients → Scripts → pick a script
pages.summary: Read one sales-call script part by part, fill in the gaps with the prospect's details, and copy ready-made messages.
controls: **All scripts** link at the top of the left list, goes back to the scripts list
**Overview** in the left list, the script's cover page with its parts listed
Numbered parts in the left list, each opens one part of the script
**Start with part 1** button on the Overview cover (shows **Start the call** on the Profit Roadmap call)
**Tips** button at the top right of a part, opens a side panel of coaching notes (only shown when the part has notes)
**Clear details** button at the top right of a part, wipes what you typed into the gaps (only shown once you have typed something)
Grey and blue fill-ins inside the script, click one to type your own words, Enter saves, Esc cancels, **Clear** empties it
**Copy** button on message boxes, copies a text, email or DM with the gaps kept in brackets
Click-to-open answer boxes under **Click the best match**, open the reply for what the prospect said
Small ⓘ next to some replies, shows why on hover or tap
Links to other scripts or objection pages inside the script

**Search playbooks** box, **Browse all playbooks** button, **Their level** and **Their constraint** pickers in the playbook helper, shows questions to ask and quick wins (only on parts that include it)
pages.notes: The Profit Roadmap call opens a live call screen instead: call phases down the left, **Who's the call with?**, **Call notes** box, **Listen**, **New call**, **Call details**, the pitch with **Personalise**, and a **Tips** button. What you type into the gaps stays in this browser and is shared across all scripts. Your price and first name fill in automatically, and the Profit Levers button inside scripts is admin-only, so never offer it.}

pages.title: Call Practice
pages.where: Win Clients → Call Practice
pages.summary: Practise a sales call out loud with an AI business owner, then get a score and a report.
controls: **Surprise me** button at the top (picks a random owner, call and level)
Row of owner faces with left and right arrows: pick who you practise with
**Start** button in the middle (opens the call and uses your microphone)
Call menu under the heading **What to practise**: choose which sales call to practise
**Start at** buttons (**The whole call** or a later part of the call) for calls that allow it
**Objections** buttons with a **Surprise me** link: pick up to four objections to face, for the objection calls
**Level** buttons (Easy, Medium, Hard): how tough the owner is
**Voice speed** buttons: **Normal** or **Quick**
**Tips during the call** switch
**Your calls** list at the bottom: past practice calls with date, level, outcome and score, each opens its report
During a call: **Script** button (script follows what you say), **Help** button, **Pause**, mute microphone button, **End and get feedback**
On pause: **How am I doing?**, **Back to the call**, **End and get feedback**, **End without saving**
pages.notes: Your browser must allow the microphone, and voice must be set up on the server, or Start stays off. The practice minutes each month are shared with the Client Simulator; when they run out, Start is blocked until the 1st. A call that is too short is not scored.}

pages.title: Call practice report
pages.where: Win Clients → Call Practice, then open a past practice call from the list (or finish a practice call and it opens here)
pages.summary: See the score and feedback for one practice sales call, play it back, and practise again.
controls: **Call simulator** link at the top left, back to Call Practice
Score ring at the top right, showing a score out of 100
Outcome badge: **Won**, **Next step** or **No next step**
**Practise again** button, restarts the same prospect, call and level
**Open the script** button, opens the script used for the call
**The call** or **The objections** card, with each part scored; tap a row to see the evidence and a **Better** line
**Sales skills** card, with each skill scored
**Moments from the call** cards, tagged **Worked well** or **Missed chance**, with **Try instead** lines
**Your one thing for next time** box
**What you found out** tiles, showing which facts you found (dashed ones were not found)
**The call** section with the transcript: a play button, a waveform to jump around, a playback speed button, and **Part 1**, **Part 2** switches if the call was paused
**Show the whole call** button, shows the full transcript (**Show less** to collapse)
**Try scoring again** button, appears if scoring takes over a minute
pages.notes: A call that is still being scored shows "Scoring your call" and updates by itself. A call too short to score says "This call was too short to score." **Practise again**, **Open the script** and **Try scoring again** only show on the coach's own calls; the coach name shows when viewing someone else's report.

pages.title: Search
pages.where: Search box at the top of the coach app (Esc takes you back to the page you came from), or open the Search page directly
pages.summary: Search the Academy for lessons, videos, resources, community posts and members, and reopen things you looked at recently.
controls: **Search lessons, videos, posts and people** search box at the top
**Clear search** (X) button inside the box once you type
**Ask Ava** button in the box (also **Ask Ava instead** when nothing is found), sends your words to Ava
**Recently opened** list shown while the box is empty or under two letters, with lessons, resources, prospects and clients
**Classroom**, **Community** and **Members** tabs with result counts, shown once you search
**Previous** and **Next** buttons with page numbers under long result lists
Buttons like "3 in Community" when the current tab has no hits but another tab does
Like and comment buttons on community post results
pages.notes: Searching needs at least two letters; tabs and results only appear after that. Classroom results show matching words from lessons, transcripts ("Said at" time) and resources. The Ask Ava buttons only show when Ava is switched on for the coach.The community post and member avatars may show an Admin label or green online dot, which is informational only.

pages.title: Settings
pages.where: Click your profile or account area, then Settings (the page at /coach/settings)
pages.summary: Update your profile, connect your accounts, manage billing and see your ladder.
controls: **Profile photo** button at the top of the profile card: choose **Upload avatar** or **Remove avatar**
First name, last name, business name, location and time zone in the profile card, with a map pin you can change or clear
**LinkedIn** field with an **Import** button in the Community card
**Bio** field in the Community card, shown in the community roster and members map
**Edit your page** button in the Directory page card (opens your directory page in a new tab)
**Notes** box in the Reply style card, for how Ava drafts your replies
**Change email** and **Change password** buttons in the Account card
**Get the app on your phone** card at the top of the right column, with steps and a code to scan
**Integrations** card with **Refresh** and a **Connect** button for Google, Outlook, Zoom, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, Instagram and Facebook
**Ava reply alerts** card: choose Off, Copilot or Autopilot, then pick where Ava tells you
Under Ava's nudges, **Pause for** 1 week, 2 weeks or 1 month, then **Turn back on**
In Billing: **Manage billing**, **View plans**, **Update payment method**, **Change plan**, and **Invoice** download buttons
In Billing, **Change** or **Add details** sets who your invoices are made out to
pages.notes: Profile fields save by themselves a moment after you stop typing, and a Saved note appears at the top. The Directory page card only shows if you have a directory page. Autopilot is marked Coming soon, so don't offer it; the Voice card is admin-only and coaches never see it.

pages.title: Links
pages.where: Get Calls → Toolkit → Links

controls: **Public URL** field with **Save** at the top right, sets the slug in theprofitcoach.com/your-name
**Your pages** card with **Edit page** and a copy button for the Constraint Call page and BOSS Score page
**Scorecards** group: Boss Score and Boss Score Pro, each with copy and share buttons
**Book a call** group: your public calendars with **Call page** and **Booking page** edit buttons, copy and share, plus **Manage in Calls** link
**Reports** group: Boss Score report and Boss Score Pro dashboard, each with a share button
**Profiles** group: **Add** to save LinkedIn, website or other social links, then **Save**
**Your links** group: **Add** a custom link with **Title**, **URL** and **Description (optional)**, then **Edit** or **Delete**
**Share** pop-up with **Anyone** and **One person** switch, **Search prospects**, **Message** box, channel buttons (WhatsApp, LinkedIn, Email, SMS), **Copy link**, **Copy** and **Send**
**Tag a link, see where people come from** box: choose a **Link**, **Where you'll use it**, **Name it (optional)**, then **Copy link**
pages.notes: Set your public URL first: until then the amber warning shows, the Your pages card and tag maker are hidden, and copy and share buttons are disabled. Send in the share pop-up opens a conversation in Conversations with the message ready. Edit page buttons open the public page in a new tab where the words are changed directly.

**Level** buttons for the difficulty, plus **Voice speed** with **Normal** and **Quick**

**Certification** card with **Start certification**, **Next session** or **Try again**

pages.title: Session report

**Your one thing for next time** box
**What the client shared** and **What the client agreed to** lists

**Show the whole call** / **Show less** button under the transcript

Buttons for Ava, Practise again, Share and replay only appear on the coach's own sessions; a shared session from another coach is read-only. The share pop-up has Title and Post fields, Score Show/Hide, Post in Feedback/Wins, **Post it**, **Cancel**, and **Stop sharing the report** once shared.

pages.title: Support

Message box in a chat, to write to BCA and add files

**Search for an answer** box on the Help tab
**Browse by topic** cards on the Help tab: Getting started, Academy, Blueprint, Get clients, Keep clients, Account and money

Help answers still waiting on Zander or Pam to confirm, the admin counts and the admin-only notes are shown to admins only, so never offer them to coaches.

pages.title: Toolkit

controls: **Documents you send** heading on the Brochure tab, with a preview of the 90-day programme
**Show the fee** tick box under the brochure preview (price is off by default)
**Print or save PDF** button under the brochure preview
Buttons linking to the Blueprint sections to fill in, shown when the brochure isn't ready
**PDF** button on print items (opens print view)
**PNG** button on each graphic
**SVG** button on each graphic, for a designer
**Event name** field on the event banner card (starts as Profit Workshop)
